Name: Shane Sings 99 Bottles of Beer
Author: MouseyPounds
Description:
[b]Description:

[color=#ffff00]Shane Sings "99 Bottles of Beer"[/color][/b] is a Content Patcher mod which changes Shane's dialogue so that on Friday nights in the Saloon he sings the entire "99 Bottles of Beer" song. There is no escaping the dialogue once the song starts, so be ready to click through the whole thing. I'm sorry about that. Oh, and don't click on him after he's done or he'll start the whole thing again -- you have been warned.



[b]Installation:
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Unzip the X download and place the included [color=#b6d7a8][code][CP] 99 Bottles[/code][/color] folder into your [color=#b6d7a8][code]Mods[/code][/color] folder.
[/list]

[b]
Additional Notes:
[/b]
[list]
[*]To paraphrase [i]Jurassic Park's[/i] Ian Malcolm: "Sometimes modders are so preoccupied with whether they could that they don’t stop to think if they should."
[*]Screenshots feature NPC sprites and portraits from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2449]Seasonal Villager Outfits[/url]﻿ mod.
[/list][b]


Compatibility:
[/b]
[list]
[*]May have minor conflicts with other Shane dialogue mods if they also implement the "Saloon_Fri" dialogue key.
[*][b][color=#ffff00][b][color=#ffff00]Shane Sings "99 Bottles of Beer"[/color][/b][/color][/b] requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] version 1.4 or higher (which means it also requires [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] version 2.6 or higher); it may work with earlier versions of Stardew Valley but was only tested on 1.3.36.
[/list]
